posts.text: Sorry you feel that way.   Two people below you believes I am “in the tank” for the President — I’ll just cover the news.  Thanks for watching

TONIGHT: Please tune in tonight 6pmEST for @specialreport. Ill sit down with new @dhsgov Secretary Markwayne Mullin. We will cover a host of topics, including his first weeks on the job, ending the government shutdown and threats to the homeland amidst the Iran war. #foxnews #specialreport

Thanks for joining us this week-- Happy Easter to all who celebrate! I'll see you in Monday where I will sit down with the new DHS secretary for his first interview #FoxNews #SpecialReport

POTUS HAS BEEN BRIEFED ON THE DOWNED US F-15 IN IRAN - a Centcom statement is expected soon.  H/t @pdoocy
The DHS reports nearly 3 million deportations and self-deportations since the start of President Trumps term. @Senator Markwayne Mullin urges those in the U.S. illegally to self deport.
@Senator Markwayne Mullin shares the story behind his double name and the infamous red ball. Thank you for having me!  #dhs #interview
Tonight Markwayne Mullin will be joining me for his first interview as DHS Secretary on #specialreport at 6PM ET on @Fox News
Happy Easter from my family to yours! #Easter

“If we don’t protect these programs from fraud, they will be destroyed.” Dr. Mehmet Oz joined me to discuss the urgent need to shield Medicare and Medicaid from corruption to ensure they remain solvent.
Dr. Mehmet Oz says “throwing money” at problems during the COVID-19 pandemic made it easier for fraudsters to corrupt the system #specialreport #healthcare
Happy Good Friday 🐣🌷Be sure to tune in tonight show we have a lot to cover and I’ll be joined by Dr. Oz to talk about fraud in the healthcare system and other topics #specialreport #news #goodfriday
Tonight I was joined by Kevin Book, managing director of Clearview Energy partners and he shared his thoughts on the rising costs of gas due to the conflict in Iran #specialreport #gas #energy
Artemis II is now on its way to the Moon, marking a major step in NASA’s return to deep space exploration  #atremis #nasa #space #astronaut
“We were within 15 seconds of calling an abort.” Apollo astronaut Brig Gen Charles Duke reflects on the pressure inside Mission Control during the Moon landing #specialreport
